name: What is the renovation process with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the renovation process with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our renovation process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we develop a detailed proposal and design plan. Once approved, we handle permit acquisition if needed. Construction then commences, managed by our experienced team, with regular communication. Finally, we conduct a walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction before project completion. We aim for a smooth and transparent experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, proposal, design, permitting, construction, and a final walkthrough for your satisfaction.
